architecture.unfrozen: Copied U-Net condition MLP and all FiLM affine layers plus copied terminal mean convolution.
architecture.frozen: Original models; copied nonconditioning convolutions, group norms, mean time map, charge map, stochastic M0 bases and electronics.
architecture.source_input: Full normalized waveform, source logQ and log amplitude, original detector condition. No event IDs as inputs.
architecture.zero_start_function: Zero-start function difference M_inherited+qbar*(U_train-U_initial), evaluated with the same parent microbatches. GPU synthetic identity0 and adjoint error8.94e-8; original baseline unchanged.

trend_contract.grid: Two FIT shape prototypes from prior declared source-PSD groups;128 evenly spaced logQ coordinates within each group support.
trend_contract.features: Mean normalized SOURCE features and filtered shapes; log amplitude follows same physical amplitude rescaling as logQ.
trend_contract.loss: Mean squared second derivative of canonical-charge-normalized full384 mean waveform in logQ, each group normalized once by its inherited value; equal group weights.
trend_contract.coverage: All6465 FIT parents and all18948 REAL FIT rows remain in distribution supervision. Prototype trend covers6301 dominant-template rows; other164 retained.
trend_contract.purpose: Suppress diagnosed cross-Q oscillation while conditional waveform memory protects actual shape; no monotonicity law imposed.

optimizer_contract.method: Adam plus wave/Q-wave/trend,5 evidence-derived conditional cells, and2 ADC gradients; at most11 native probes.
optimizer_contract.exact_adjoint: Cache one mean per FIT parent; sum all draw adjoints, then replay U-Net per parent chunk. Synthetic equality tested.
optimizer_contract.constraints: Existing supported92 conditional-wave cells and Q-wave nonincrease, global wave nonincrease, Q+0.5%, peak+1%, PSD nonincrease, both trend risks nonincrease and both ADC risks nonincrease.
optimizer_contract.commit: Hard original ADC/readout; every constraint and flag count passes, with strict PSD, Q-wave, objective and both trend reductions.
optimizer_contract.stop: Exactly1 direction, at most11 native probes at radius0.05 and3 hard combination scales; no sweep, no extension.

endpoint_contract.existing: Fresh two-bank32: >=10% PSD improvement vs original, Q/wave/peak <=+2%, flags not increased; Q-wave improves vs inherited and all supported cells <=+2%.
endpoint_contract.added: Both full-wave curvature risks and128 equal-count fixed-window median-PSD excess variations <=50% of inherited values; at least1 actual update.
endpoint_contract.scope: FIT pilot only. Fixed REPORT evaluation only after pilot gates; REPORT never trains or selects settings. No physical response acceptance from FIT alone.

operation_budget.derivation: Initial1 pair + gradient2 pairs +11 probes +3 trials =17*103440;3 independent endpoint models add1241280.

storage.policy: Active training weights/arrays on compute storage; no duplicate large backups or NAS checks.

measured_budget_basis.wake_rule: Confirm actual native startup, use measured first-stage timing plus remaining workload and margin.

evidence.missing_directions: Positive native changes in L16_13, L32_24 and L16_12 certify the finite cones were blocked.
evidence.local_radius_reason: At unit probe radius even Q-wave descent increased its own hard risk and PSD rose8x-22x for several directions; use previously implemented0.05 local radius once, without a radius sweep.
evidence.budget_rule: Exactly1 new direction and at most11 probes/3 hard trials; no automatic additional directions regardless of result.
